current_effective_implementation.definition: Dimensionless effective mixing amplitude in the implemented UniverseLab 4D bridge sensitivity function.
direct_source_statements: guide.html: beta_tau is an effective mixing amplitude.
guide.html: beta_tau and I_B occur only as a product and are degenerate in this bridge model.
guide.html: beta_tau -> 0 removes the correction and reproduces LambdaCDM within the implementation.
compare-app.js: the bridge correction is model-dependent, dimensionless, and not a released fundamental 6D prediction.
hyperlab.html: displayed curves visualize effective ansatzes, not predictions calculated from the full 6D parent action.
current_effective_implementation.effective_dimension_basis: compare-app.js declares Delta dimensionless; guide.html declares I_B dimensionless; a/a_c and the exponential are dimensionless, so the implemented beta_tau proxy is dimensionless.

identifiability.reason: The current correction depends on beta_tau and I_B only through their product.
identifiability.zero_limit: beta_tau -> 0 gives Delta -> 0 and the implemented LambdaCDM limit.
